observation_authority_note: Level 2 — exact source-faithful reconstruction using complete captured runtime inputs. Level 1 (an actual historically captured summarizer request) is UNAVAILABLE_FROM_TRACE: the matched latency trace carries no summarizer-request payload and the compaction sidecar stores only the INSTALLED continuation, not the request that produced it.
reconstruction_method: The production modules were invoked directly over the captured canonical transcript: extractVerifiedToolOutcomes() (evidence-continuity.ts), serializeConversation() (compaction-shared.ts), findCutIndex() (compaction-shared.ts), buildBudgetProjection() (budget-projection/project.ts), applyVerifiedEvidenceToCompactedMessages() (evidence-continuity.ts). The reconstruction does NOT concatenate the first 245/263 messages and call it the summarizer input; it measures the actual production projection.

selection.cut_boundary_rule: snap-forward to an assistant message or a typed-user turn; never split a tool_use/tool_result pair

summarizer_input_projection.projection_mechanism: flattenToolResultContent() -> truncateToolResultContentForCompaction() -> renderToolResultBlocks() -> renderStructuredToolPayload(); the per-result status and an allowlisted command classification are kept; every arbitrary output string is replaced by the '[result omitted]' marker

verified_outcome_ledger.retention_semantics: the 12 most RECENT outcomes are kept; earlier ones are evicted
verified_outcome_ledger.command_subject_classification_cause: Every Round C command begins with 'cd <path> && <cmd>'. classifyCommand() matches the command's LEADING WORDS against a finite allowlist that does not contain 'cd', so the classification is empty and the carried line degrades to 'succeeded — N commands' with no command identity.

generated_summary_self_reported_gaps: preserved command stdout and exact citations are missing
R7 remains unresolved; Maven evidence must be recollected

continuation_projection.verified_operations_represented_in_conti: status and command count only; no command classification and no output body

unavailable_fields: estimated_request_input_tokens for the exact compaction-decision requests (the trace's compaction diagnostics carry only compactionInitiated and effectiveMaxInputTokens)
the generated summary's generator-side token accounting

hypothesis_disposition.H1_input_omission: REPRODUCED — the result BODY is deliberately omitted at flattenToolResultContent() (487 omitted bodies); the command CLASSIFICATION that would identify the subject is ALSO absent for every Round C call because the 'cd <path> && ' prefix defeats the leading-word allowlist.
hypothesis_disposition.H2_generative_omission: NOT_ISOLATED — the actual summarizer request is UNAVAILABLE_FROM_TRACE, so a generator-side omission cannot be separated from the input-side omission for the specific facts.
hypothesis_disposition.H3_post_summary_loss: NOT_REPRODUCED for the verified-outcome section — the deterministic carry-forward IS present in the installed continuation (12 lines). The loss of the R1/R7 SEMANTIC facts occurs BEFORE the summary, not after it.
hypothesis_disposition.H4_privacy_retention_limitation: PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE — the arbitrary-output omission is a deliberate confidentiality policy (the 12-outcome bound is also working as specified). The empty command-classification set is NOT the stated policy: it is an allowlist-matching miss, not a deliberate omission.
